observation: Captured in open-1 (siteId empty_skin, strainId charon_grave, driveState drift, draws 2, size 2.16 x 41.40 x 54.00 WU). In default yaw=0 60-degree chase and close views, the creature presents dead edge-on as a 2.16 WU vertical rod bisecting the frame and clipping out both top and bottom edges in both views. Construction is 2 bare primitives: a thin 0.06-scale compressed SphereGeometry blade (bs_sail, untextured: map null, normalMap null, dark smooth metallic finish) and a brown tissue-mapped CylinderGeometry spine (bs_cord) dominating the edge-on silhouette. Because edge-on framing hides the broadside sail and the sail lacks texture or folded membrane structure, silhouette and material readability fail. Broadside scan-flip, active flee posture, and ordinary play were not captured.
decision: disposition: needs follow-up — edge-on sliver clips top/bottom in both views leaving sail unreadable, plus untextured featureless ellipsoid sail primitive and bare cylinder spine.
next: Rebuild the sail with organic creased photophore membrane geometry and textured/normal-mapped surface detail (retaining edge-on profile without bare cylinder dominance), add angled inspection coverage for broadside readability, and recapture.
